The company demonstrates moderate profitability with an EBIT of $158M and net income of $64M on $724M in revenue, alongside a solid asset base of $3,464M. However, it carries a relatively high leverage profile with total liabilities of $2,635M against $829M in shareholders' equity, as well as a tight liquidity position with current liabilities ($470M) exceeding current assets ($338M). This combination of stable operating earnings offset by elevated leverage and modest liquidity supports an investment-grade rating at the BBB level.

DECISION: BBB
